## Deferrals read

All of `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md`. Rows in scope: none — this ticket repairs a code defect

`## Progress`.

## Requirements (contract)

1. Server-side `decided_at` authority: additive sqitch change giving
   `publication_disposition.decided_at` a DB default (`clock_timestamp()`); the writer
   stops stamping host time — explicit `decided_at` accepted only as documented
   replay/migration input; otherwise the column is omitted from the INSERT. Committed
   values stay readable (append-only, no rewrite).
2. Regression test: record → immediately-select under the real PG container is visible;
   the test fails on the pre-fix path (assert the INSERT carries no Python-now value /
   fake a skewed host clock).
3. Sweep: any other writer stamping `datetime.now(UTC)` into a column that SQL-side
   filters compare against the server clock — fix only if same defect class in the same
   surface; otherwise open a DEFERRALS row.

## Acceptance criteria → test matrix

| # | AC | Test |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Host clock no longer participates in `decided_at` for normal writes; explicit `decided_at` accepted only as documented replay input | `test_normal_write_carries_no_host_stamp` (capture-stub: INSERT omits the column when `decided_at` is None; explicit replay carries it) |
| 2 | Record → immediately-select visible under real PG; fails pre-fix | `test_recorded_disposition_is_immediately_visible`, `test_host_clock_skew_cannot_hide_a_recorded_disposition` (monkeypatched +1h host clock — deterministic pre-fix fail) |
| 3 | The DB default is pinned + verified | `test_decided_at_default_is_the_database_clock`; sqitch `disposition_decided_at_authority` verify |
| 4 | Carrier parity — a future-dated replay row is recorded history but never the current effective disposition on either carrier | `test_future_dated_replay_is_not_the_effective_disposition` |
| 5 | Verification green; repeated flaky-file runs stable; closeout per protocol | `make check` + `make test-db` + repeated `tests/db/test_publication_dispositions.py` runs |

## Plan

- **sqitch:** new change `disposition_decided_at_authority` — deploy re-asserts
  `ALTER COLUMN decided_at SET DEFAULT clock_timestamp()` (the `publication_dispositions`
  change already created the default; this pins it durably) + `COMMENT ON COLUMN`
  recording the single-clock-authority contract; verify asserts the default exists;
  revert restores the documented prior state. `db/sqitch.plan` entry.
- **`policy/eligibility.py`:** `DispositionRecord.decided_at` → `datetime | None`
  (None = the DB stamps it at INSERT); `new_disposition` drops `datetime.now(UTC)`;
  `latest_disposition` never selects an un-stamped record.
- **`db/dispositions.py`:** `record_disposition` omits `decided_at` from the INSERT
  unless an explicit replay value is present; `effective_dispositions` bounds
  `decided_at <= COALESCE(%s, clock_timestamp())` for SQL-twin parity (same defect
  class, same file/surface); `dispositions_for` history stays unfiltered.
- **tests:** the matrix above in `tests/db/test_publication_dispositions.py`.

## Progress

- 2026-09-27 — Loaded contract docs; baseline `tests/db/test_publication_dispositions.py`
  18/18 on real PG18+PostGIS (flake is intermittent — green baseline expected).
- Sweep (deliverable 3): every OTHER writer of a server-clock-compared column already
  omits it or uses `COALESCE(%s, clock_timestamp())` — `ingest_run_completion.finished_at`
  (`db/run_completion._INSERT`), `ingest_run.started_at`, `review_decision.decided_at`,
  `rights_decision.decided_at`, `resolution.decided_at`/`sys_period`,
  `claim_evidence.bound_at`, `camera_site_match.decided_at`,
  `camera_site_run.completed_at`, `camera_site_execution.completed_at`,
  `claim.sys_period` — all DB-stamped. `publication_disposition.decided_at` via
  `new_disposition`/`record_disposition` was the sole write path stamping host time into
  a column the SQL eligibility fragments compare against `clock_timestamp()`.
  Boundary observation (different class — read-side as-of `belief` pins, not writer
  stamps): `reconcile/materialize.py:1259`, `api/store_pg.py:1145` pass host `now` as the
  caller-pinned belief instant to `sys_period @>`/`bound_at <=` filters — the as-of
  instant is the query's semantics (ADR-123), and Docker-Desktop skew direction
  (container behind host) makes those reads inclusive, not hiding. Recorded, not a
  defect; no DEFERRALS row opened.
- Sweep finding 2 (different defect class + surface → deferred): whole-plan
  `sqitch verify` divides by zero on a fully deployed DB —
  `verify/shared_temporal_contract.sql:30` asserts `spine_watermark count(*) = 27`
  but P32.5's `publication_dispositions` added a 28th facet
  (`publication_disposition`). Stale since P32.5; invisible to `make check` /
  `make test-db` (those `deploy` only — verify scripts are never run).
  Opened `D-P32.10a-1` (kind V, cites BL-058) — the repair shape is a maintainer
  decision (editing a landed change's verify script is an in-place edit the
  sqitch convention discourages). Migration anchors regenerated
  (`obligation_events.py migrate --recorded-at 2026-09-27` → 90 anchors;
  `check` green, 4 assessments consistent).
- Implemented per plan: sqitch change `disposition_decided_at_authority`
  (deploy/revert/verify + plan entry); `eligibility.new_disposition` no longer
  stamps `datetime.now(UTC)` (`decided_at: datetime | None` = un-stamped);
  `latest_disposition` excludes un-stamped records (SQL-twin parity);
  `record_disposition` omits `decided_at` unless an explicit replay/migration
  value is passed; `effective_dispositions` applies the same
  `decided_at <= COALESCE(%s::timestamptz, clock_timestamp())` bound the SQL
  twin carries; tests in `tests/db/test_publication_dispositions.py` (+5: the
  four matrix rows + an explicit replay-path stub).

## Evidence report

- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/170a_P32.10a__disposition-single-clock-authority.md`
  (SIG Round 10 inserted row 170.5 / manifest seq 170a). **PR:** #166 stacked
  on the P32.10 tip; impl `b132bbb` + closeout commit. **Requirement:** a
  defect repair of SIG-TRUST-006 inside the ADR-124 family — no new id, no ADR
  amendment, no semantics change.
- **Fix shape:** `new_disposition`/`record_disposition` no longer send a host
  `decided_at` for normal writes — the column is omitted so
  `DEFAULT clock_timestamp()` (re-pinned + commented by the additive sqitch
  change `disposition_decided_at_authority`) stamps it; explicit values remain
  a documented replay/migration input. `effective_dispositions` gained the
  SQL-twin's `decided_at <= COALESCE(%s, clock_timestamp())` bound so
  future-dated replay rows are history, never the current effective
  disposition — on both carriers (`latest_disposition` likewise ignores
  un-stamped/future-dated records). Append-only preserved; no row rewritten.
- **Regression evidence:** pre-fix tree → `3 failed, 20 passed` in the target
  file (failures exactly the new skew/stamp/parity tests); post-fix → 23/23
  ×3 + the full DB suite 398 + `make check` 4,847/3/0.
- **Not done (explicit):** whole-plan `sqitch verify` stays red on the
  *pre-existing* `spine_watermark` facet-count staleness (27-vs-28, a
  different defect class/surface — `D-P32.10a-1` opened, kind V). This
  change's own deploy/revert/verify was exercised end-to-end on a real
  container and is green. No live/hosted/public verification claimed
  (`live_verification=false`). No merge/tag/push-main.
